fields.Name: T294 - Integrations Delete Confirmation Overlay
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke inline card delete-confirmation overlay (ShowDeleteConfirm/CancelDelete/IsDeleteConfirming) — a distinct destructive-guard UX, not the generic record delete flow.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. On a connection card, click the trash-can delete icon in the card footer. Verify an inline confirmation overlay appears over the card reading 'Delete this integration and all its entity maps?' with 'Delete' and 'Cancel' buttons. Click Cancel and confirm the overlay dismisses and the card remains. Do NOT click Delete. Seeing the confirm overlay appear and dismiss on Cancel is success. If no connections exist, a clear empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the trash icon shows an inline overlay warning about deleting the integration and its entity maps
The overlay presents Delete and Cancel buttons
Clicking Cancel dismisses the overlay and the connection card remains
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
